figure_categories.label: Real World
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: World of causally real physical entities; multiverse motivation is noted.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Temporary physical branch in Fig.1.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Temporary mental branch in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Physical Magnitude
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Magnitude branch; temperature example varies continuously.

figure_categories.label: Physical Connection
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Connections support material integrity and truthmakers of qualitative change.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Mental persistent category; includes Concepts, Events, Properties, Propositions and fictional-world structure in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Psychical Occurrent
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Mental occurrence branch, with Judging and Representing.

figure_categories.label: Physical Object
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Material object category, e.g. patient/physician/thermometer.

figure_categories.label: Physical Process
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Process branch under physical substrate; avoid equating its name to DOLCE perdurant.

figure_categories.label: Object Quality
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Quality inherent to an object; temperature example.

figure_categories.label: Process Quality
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Quality of process, displayed in Fig.1 without a detailed axiom set here.

figure_categories.label: Concept
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Subject-specific vehicle for thinking its object; not identical to variable conception.

figure_categories.label: Event

figure_categories.label: Property
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Psychical continuant category; relation specializes it in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Proposition
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Psychical continuant category displayed without detailed core axioms here.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Created world in which characters can be physical; also presented within the mental taxonomy.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Concept with an in-itself existing represented target; D1.

figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Concept lacking that reference status; D2.

figure_categories.label: State
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Specialization of Event in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Change
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Specialization of Event in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Relation
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Specialization of Property in Fig.1.

figure_categories.label: Judging
figure_categories.attributed_paraphrase: Psychical Occurrent branch; existence attribution is an act of judgment.

selected_commitments.bounded_reading: WorldlyEntity(x) implies exists-unique w: World(w) and in(x,w). This encodes exactly one world per entity, not a separate axiom about all possible cross-world counterparts.

TemporaryEntity(x) implies some Time t with presentAt(x,t), and some Time t with NOT presentAt-accented(x,t). The printed second predicate contains an accented e; retain the mismatch rather than silently unifying symbols.
Concept(x) implies exists-unique y: HumanBeing(y) and possessedBy(x,y). Individual human possessor, not collective subject.
Entity(x) implies exists-unique y: object(y,x). This gives each entity one concept; it does not give each concept exactly one object.
As printed: existsAsSuch(x) implies Concept(x). Surrounding prose and D1-D2 instead use existsInItself. No equivalence axiom between these names is printed.

ReferentialConcept(x) iff Concept(x) and existsInItself(x). Non-ReferentialConcept(x) iff Concept(x) and NOT existsInItself(x). Predicate typography includes a hyphen; implementation needs an explicit encoding decision.
represents(x,y) and Non-referentialConcept(y) imply Non-referentialConcept(x). Capitalization differs across formulas; preserve source identity.

source_discrepancies: A12 existsAsSuch versus surrounding existsInItself and D1-D2
A11 inverse uniqueness is not uniqueness of object per concept
A14/A15 mixed reference-status propagation is conditionally incompatible under normalized D1/D2
